verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents REST endpoints, including exception reporting, faults, deployments, and source-map upload. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API explorer or runnable 'try it' examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no machine-readable spec that would typically power such a console. Static endpoint docs do not satisfy an interactive, runnable reference, so this applicable axis gets 'none'.
